references.title: DWDS: Gespenst
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: ahd. gispensti 'Verlockung', on spanan 'locken', a verb that died out

notes.rationale: a ghost. The ge- is fossilized: no Wortzerlegung confirms the cut, so it stays inside the Root. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word: the Root gespenst and the zero ending (ADR 0051).
